title: feat: reward issue reporters after fixes merge
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a repeatable 3 Quest Pollen reward per reported issue closed by a merged PR.
- Uses the reporter’s linked GitHub ID and an issue-specific reward key; repeat checks cannot pay twice.
- Includes PRs merged since 2026-03-27 19:45 UTC (the 180 days before launch).
- Excludes app submissions, quest issues, automated issues, and community publisher access requests, including older unlabeled submissions.
- Tests the cutoff, exclusions, claiming, and idempotency.

gist.headline: Good bug reports bear pollen
gist.blurb: A well-spotted issue can now bloom into 3 Pollen once the fix lands. The hive has started leaving tiny thank-you notes for people who notice the loose floorboards.
gist.summary: Added a repeatable 3 Pollen Quest reward for GitHub issue reporters when a linked fix PR merges, using each reporter’s linked GitHub ID and an issue-specific key to ensure every eligible report is rewarded only once.
gist.impact: People whose eligible reported issues are fixed by merged PRs—including fixes merged since 2026-03-27 19:45 UTC—can claim 3 Pollen per issue, while app submissions, Quest issues, automated reports, and publisher-access requests stay out of the reward path.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a warm, observant bug gardener: she spots a tiny pixel bug on a code-plant and pins a small issue note to it, while a freshly repaired plant blooms into a 3-Pollen flower. A linked GitHub-style issue card and a single stamped reward token convey that each useful report gets one claim after its fix merges; a cheerful CRT Monitor Robot can hold the merged code printout.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden workshop, Polli—the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown horizontal stripes, black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, light blue rounded wings, and a tiny gardener tool belt—pins an issue note beside a repaired code-plant blooming with a glowing "3 POLLEN" flower, while a chunky CRT monitor robot proudly holds a merged code printout. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm cream soil, lavender and peach flowers, subtle CRT glow, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike; pixel-font text: "FIXED" and "3 POLLEN", nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
